title.justification: This is the title of the paper.
title.quote: The 35th Canadian Conference on Artificial Intelligence

extractions.description: This paper explores the use of contextual bandit algorithms to optimize parameters in super-resolution microscopy, specifically STED nanoscopy, to improve imaging quality and reduce sample damage.
